models.name: KMeans
models.label: K-Means Clustering
models.description: Fast and scalable clustering algorithm that groups data into a predefined number of clusters.

parameters.name: auto_k
parameters.label: Auto Select Clusters
parameters.description: Automatically determine optimal number of clusters using the Elbow method.

parameters.name: n_clusters
parameters.label: Number of Clusters
parameters.description: Defines how many customer segments to create.

models.name: HDBSCAN
models.label: Density-Based Clustering (Advanced)
models.description: Automatically finds clusters based on data density without requiring a predefined number of clusters.

parameters.name: min_cluster_size
parameters.label: Cluster Size (Granularity)
parameters.description: Minimum number of points required to form a cluster.
parameters.business_mapping: Minimum size of a customer segment.

parameters.name: min_samples
parameters.label: Clustering Strictness
parameters.description: Controls how strictly clusters are formed.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.label: Distance Metric
parameters.description: Defines how similarity between data points is calculated.
